module.purpose: Implements the core useBaseQuery React hook that wires React rendering lifecycle to a TanStack Query observer, handling suspense, error boundaries, optimistic results, and subscription.
module.summary: This file exports a generic React hook that serves as the foundation for all query hooks in TanStack Query v5. It takes options, an Observer class, and an optional query client, then sets up an observer instance via useState, subscribes to it using useSyncExternalStore, handles suspense and error boundary throwing, and returns the query result while tracking property usage if needed. It also supports experimental prefetch-in-render and restoring state.
module.businessContext: Part of TanStack Query React adapter. Enables declarative data fetching with caching, suspense, error boundaries. If broken, queries won't render or update.
